hero.title: Custom tools for small businesses.
hero.accent: Stop running yours on spreadsheets and sticky notes.
hero.lead: I build simple software for teams of 1–50, made around how you already work. No big agency, no account managers. You talk to me.

pains: You're the owner, the scheduler, and the bookkeeper.
Your Excel file works, but only one person understands it.
Customer info is scattered across texts, emails, and notebooks.
Invoices go out by hand every week.
You copy the same data into three different places.
Jobs fall through the cracks when someone is out sick.

builds.title: Job & order tracker
builds.text: Every job, its status, and who's on it in one place.

builds.title: Simple CRM
builds.text: Customers, notes, and history, instead of a phone full of texts.

builds.title: Scheduling & reminders
builds.text: Bookings and automatic reminders, so fewer no-shows.

builds.title: Invoicing & reports
builds.text: Invoices from finished jobs and a weekly report you don't have to build.

steps.title: Free 30-minute call
steps.text: You show me how things work today. I tell you what I'd build and what it costs.

steps.title: Build in 2–4 weeks
steps.text: Fixed scope and price. You try it along the way, so there are no surprises at the end.

steps.title: Support after launch
steps.text: Hosting, backups, fixes, and small changes, with a real person who answers.

about: I'm Alex, a software developer in Jacksonville with 15+ years of building web applications and business systems.
I work with small businesses directly and I'm happy to meet in person. You get one person who knows your business and your software.

items.label: Custom tool
items.note: One-time project price, agreed before work starts.

items.label: Support
items.note: Hosting, backups, fixes, and small changes.

faq.q: Is this only for bigger companies?
faq.a: No. It's built for teams of 1–50. Most of my clients are owners who do half the admin themselves.
Yes. Small changes are included in support. Bigger features are quoted separately, at a fixed price.
Yes. Your data and your tool belong to you.
The code is built on standard, widely used tools that other developers know. You get the code and your data, so anyone can take it over.
